thread_title: S. flava var. flava Montgomery Co, NC
breadcrumb: S. flava var. flava Montgomery Co, NC

posts.body_html:
Here's a "new" population of flavas that may already be in cultivation, but if they are, I haven't seen or heard of any reports! They originate from a unique site that is very hilly, which is unusual for flavas in the Carolinas! There is quite a bit of diversity in this population with some great shapes and even a few maximas! Maybe we'll find some super yellow clones here too. I'm really excited to see how these turn out in the next few years!

S. flava var. flava and maxima Montgomery Co, NC, pics taken 5/20/22:




Very yellow!




And here they are, zoomed out in the seedling section (left):


For sure, this is just the beginning of this thread, I'll post updates as the plants progress!
